mission.title: cilium: CFP: BGP Unnumbered support for BGP CPlane
mission.description: CFP: BGP Unnumbered support for BGP CPlane. Requested by 36+ users.

steps.title: Check current cilium deployment
steps.description:
Verify your cilium version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
helm list -n cilium 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working cilium installation.

steps.title: Review cilium configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant cilium configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get configmap -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=cilium
```
## Cilium Feature Proposal

Currently, users need to specify BGP peers with IP addresses. Thus, it needs explicit knowledge about the peer configuration.

steps.title: Apply the fix for CFP: BGP Unnumbered support for BGP CPlane
steps.description:
Introduce new BGP CRDs to enable a more flexible way to configure BGP in the Cilium cluster.

- CiliumBGPClusterConfig
- CiliumBGPAdvertisement
- CiliumBGPPeerConfig
- CiliumBGPNodeConfig
- CiliumBGPNodeOverrideConfig

Please take a look at
```yaml
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2alpha1"
kind: CiliumBGPPeeringPolicy
metadata:
 name: 01-bgp-peering-policy
spec: # CiliumBGPPeeringPolicySpec
 nodeSelector:
   matchLabels:
     bgp-policy: a
 virtualRouters: # []CiliumBGPVirtualRouter
 - localASN: 64512
   exportPodCIDR: true
   neighbors: # []CiliumBGPNeighbor
    - peerInterface: 'eth0' <= new
      # peerAddress: 'fc00:f853:ccd:e793::50/128'
      peerASN: 64512
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get events -n cilium --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "CFP: BGP Unnumbered support for BGP CPlane" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary:
Introduce new BGP CRDs to enable a more flexible way to configure BGP in the Cilium cluster.

- CiliumBGPClusterConfig
- CiliumBGPAdvertisement
- CiliumBGPPeerConfig
- CiliumBGPNodeConfig
- CiliumBGPNodeOverrideConfig

Please take a look at [CFP](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mqmzlDeVKmNjsnDnnHTeoiW6JcItYMyDyuOM7SYoDi4/edit#heading=h.5mwz58y9syps) for more details.
